prompts.exit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted 1993 VGA dungeon-crawler wall-face texture, later reduced to 64x64 with a shared 31-colour palette. Reference images: first is the exact aged dirty painted dungeon masonry; second is C's centred round arch layout. Preserve that same irregular chipped stone, mottled grime, old mortar, muted blue-grey stone with warm earth dirt and restrained teal dampness. This must be ARCHITECTURE BUILT INTO A WALL, never a free-standing prop, floating object, visible room, floor slab in front of camera or perspective illustration of the whole dungeon. Full-bleed square wall plane, frontal orthographic elevation, no outside margins. A single centred round arch with worn irregular voussoir stones occupies roughly x14%-86%, arch crown at y8%, threshold at y98%; dark internal opening roughly x28%-72%, from arch apex at y24% down to the threshold. Surrounding wall remains the reference masonry. Painterly early-1990s fantasy game art, broad deliberate colour planes, readable aged materials at 24 pixels. Avoid clean newly-cut grey blocks, shiny modern 3D, fine visual noise, text, labels, watermark or UI. Primary request: the abbey EXIT TO DAYLIGHT. Within the arch, a closed old dark oak door with two broad rusted iron bands, big iron hinges, one plain bronze ring handle on viewer right. The door is fitted tightly inside the stone jambs; no air or floor behind it. A THIN warm ivory crack of daylight leaks UNDER the door across the bottom threshold; a tiny hint of daylight at the centre seam is allowed, no wide bright opening. The wood is dark aged ochre, the bands are slate iron with worn pale rivets. Beautiful chipped arch stones and accumulated grime. This is one full square tile, opaque.
